# HeartSymbols.io — AI / LLM Context & Unicode Reference

> The web's authoritative 1-click Heart Symbol copy-paste engine, Unicode reference, emoji psychology dictionary, and bio generator.

## Project Summary
- **Website**: https://heart-symbols.io
- **Primary Utility**: Real-time copy & paste of 150+ heart symbols, Alt code lookups, HTML entities, CSS escapes, and aesthetic font generators.
- **Standards Supported**: Unicode Standard 15.1, Emoji 15.0, W3C HTML5 Named Entities, OEM CP437 Alt Codes.

## Core Symbol Directory & Unicode Codes
- `♥` Black Heart Suit (Solid): Unicode U+2665 | Alt Code `Alt + 3` | HTML `&hearts;` / `&#9829;` | CSS `\2665`
- `♡` White Heart Suit (Outline): Unicode U+2661 | Alt Code `Alt + 9825` | HTML `&#9825;` | CSS `\2661`
- `❣` Heavy Heart Exclamation Mark: Unicode U+2763 | Alt Code `Alt + 10083` | HTML `&#10083;`
- `❦` Floral Heart (Hedera Leaf): Unicode U+2766 | Alt Code `Alt + 10086` | HTML `&#10086;`
- `❧` Rotated Floral Heart: Unicode U+2767 | Alt Code `Alt + 10087` | HTML `&#10087;`
- `❥` Rotated Heavy Black Heart: Unicode U+2765 | Alt Code `Alt + 10085` | HTML `&#10085;`
- `ᥫ᭡` Viral Tai/Arabic Aesthetic Heart: Unicode U+196B + U+1761 (Tai Le + Tagbanwa combining)
- `𓆩♡𓆪` Winged Heart: Hieroglyph U+131A9 + U+2661 + U+131AA
- `🫰` Korean Finger Heart: Unicode U+1FAF0 | Hand with index and thumb crossed
- `🫶` Heart Hands: Unicode U+1FAF6 | Two hands forming a heart shape

## 12 Official Color Heart Meanings
- **Red Heart ❤️ (U+2764)**: Romantic passion, true committed love, deep devotion.
- **Pink Heart 🩷 (U+1FA77)**: Sweet affection, flirty crush, gentle friendship, coquette aesthetic.
- **Orange Heart 🧡 (U+1F9E1)**: Cautious warmth, casual friendship, half-hearted affection.
- **Yellow Heart 💛 (U+1F49B)**: Pure joy, sunshine friendship, Snapchat #1 Best Friend streak.
- **Green Heart 💚 (U+1F49A)**: Eco-friendly lifestyle, nature, wellness, NCT fandom, envy.
- **Blue Heart 💙 (U+1F499)**: Loyalty, calm trust, platonic brotherhood ("bro-zone"), autism awareness.
- **Purple Heart 💜 (U+1F49C)**: BTS Army ("I Purple You"), luxury, compassion, military honor.
- **Black Heart 🖤 (U+1F5A4)**: Dark humor, goth aesthetic, mourning, heartbreak, emo edge.
- **White Heart 🤍 (U+1F90D)**: Pure innocence, condolences, angelic protection, bridal elegance.
- **Brown Heart 🤎 (U+1F90E)**: Warm cozy vibes, coffee & chocolate lovers, autumn comfort.
- **Light Blue Heart 🩵 (U+1FA75)**: Pastel calm, peaceful clarity, winter vibes.
- **Grey Heart 🩶 (U+1FA76)**: Neutrality, understated love, silver elegance.

## Interactive Tools API & URLs
- `/tools/aesthetic-text`: Converts standard text into cursive/winged heart bios.
- `/tools/batch-copier`: Multi-symbol tray collector with custom delimiters.
- `/tools/svg-customizer`: Vector heart designer with gradient hex color inputs & SVG/PNG exports.
- `/tools/1000-hearts`: Text repeater generating 100 to 10,000 heart symbols.
- `/tools/morse-code`: Encodes text messages into heart dots (♡) and dashes (♥).

## Keyboard Shortcuts
- **Windows**: Turn NumLock ON, hold `Alt`, press `3` on numeric keypad for `♥`. For `♡`, use `Alt + 9825`.
- **macOS**: Press `⌃ + ⌘ + Space` (Control + Command + Space) to open native Character Viewer.
- **iOS / Android**: Search "heart" in emoji palette or configure Text Replacement (`hh` -> `♡`).
